notes.title: Optimization, new area
notes.content:
Optimized gunfire animations
Added an abandoned factory area
Added a friendly furnace town with a large amount of scrap metal recycling
Fixed several bugs

notes.title: System optimization and bug fixes
notes.content: Added dynamic city requirements and trade prices. Fixed several bugs.

notes.title: 8.28 Vehicle Update
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324480/da6a6a9490ed8d525e5120275f77d94786b826a4.png"][/img][/p][p]A new, practical vehicle, the Military Jeep, has been added. Its superior off-road performance stands out among all other combat vehicles. It can carry three weapons: a light machine gun, a small cannon, and a special weapon. While it can carry a wide range of weapons, they are all lightweight. Its price from NPCs is 8000C.[/p][p]-The price of the Van has been reduced to 4000C.[/p][p]-New weapons have been added: a 45mm light cannon and a 12.7mm air-cooled lightweight machine gun.[/p][p]-A black powder cannon has been added to the bandit enemy (don't underestimate this antique weapon!).[/p][p]-New Blacksmith town and trading location have been added.[/p]

notes.title: bug fix
notes.content: Enemies are smarter and stronger, so please be careful

notes.title: Vehicle system optimization, new vehicles
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324480/21b2ddc8eafcd1a52869c5f0b6859ed41ce8ed2e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Added a cheaper vehicle - the Urban Village Van; a low-end version of the vehicle that can carry a special weapon and a machine gun, priced at 5000C at the NPC[/p][p][/p][p]Optimized the vehicle system, with more realistic dynamic effects[/p][p][/p][p]Added simple hair calculations to female characters, making them look more normal[/p]

notes.title: Update machinery
notes.content: [p]Added two new heavy machines and one manual workbench: Lathe and Punch，Bullets can now be produced automatically[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324480/1722bb638cb1ee0af1b52e882047c7e6832ace4e.png"][/img][/p][p]Added anvil, which can manually produce simple iron products[/p][p]Added manual production: Some specific workbenches require manual production, such as firearms and assembly of simple tools[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324480/1a7680ae074c418de06ab8e8287d9e2a9fa6fe16.png"][/img][/p][p]Added blacksmith shop: If you want to buy some finished products directly, you can buy them at the blacksmith shop.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324480/07c1850073ba677a8e09dfa2448d8edf59d0592f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Adventure and Trade
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324480/f12ea916f5220915afe99593d84ce757c68052d8.png"][/img]-A new map has been added, which gathers a large number of tough enemies! Their treasures may be hidden in corners! Clear them quickly and get rewards![/p][p][/p][p]-In addition to the enemy fortress, an underground secret base has been opened, which seems to hide unspeakable secrets. It is full of lost zombies? The door at the end seems to be closed temporarily. (This is the entrance to the underground mode in future.)[/p][p][/p][p]-The initial construction of the trade system has been completed, and there are materials needed for the front line in the distant village. Although the vehicle now needs fuel, it is dangerous to run trade, so it is best not to walk over![/p]
